notes: Simplifies firearm manufacturer rules for tabletop reliability: Bastion extra attack is manual, Corvus RAM Thief is manual and restores 1d2/1d3/1d4/1d6/1d8 RAM by the wielder's Cyberdeck Mk only when the killed enemy had an installed Cyberdeck, and Helix/Jade/Vektor/Kurohane/ForgeLine weapon traits remain player-tracked.

Reframes weapon reload values as reload points: Action +2, Bonus Action +1. Adds a small actor-side manual reload tracker with +Action, +Bonus, -1, and Reset controls without spending actions or refilling ammo automatically.
ForgeLine Rivet Work Armor Anchor Plating now grants universal AC +1/+1/+2/+2/+3 after a no-move turn until the start of the wearer's next turn.
Bastion Combat Plate Take the Bullet now uses flat firearm DR 5/10/15/20/30 instead of removing damage dice.
Removes the temporary 0.11.55-0.11.57 identifier tracing infrastructure while retaining the 14.367 nested-identifier quarantine proven by the trace.
Weapon ratings/prices are intentionally retained for now; Corvus balance will be rechecked after Cyberdeck Mk/RAM values are finalized.
